headline: Nubank Suspends Direct Crypto Deposits and Withdrawals
summary: Nubank has temporarily suspended direct deposits and withdrawals of cryptocurrencies, though buying and selling services remain operational.
why: Operational changes at major fintech platforms can affect user liquidity and market access for retail crypto investors.

impacts.name: Nubank
impacts.why: Service suspension may impact user engagement and platform trust.
